command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== fixture: 3 cells x 3 genes, planted counts, UNIQUE UMI per read =="
cat > gen.awk <<'AWKEOF'
BEGIN{
  srand(11)
  split("ACGT", B, "")
  # three transcripts (500bp), 1:1 with genes
  for(t=1;t<=3;t++){ s=""; for(i=0;i<500;i++) s=s B[int(rand()*4)+1]; TX[t]=s
    printf ">t%d\n%s\n", t, s > "txome.fa"
    printf "t%d\tg%d\n", t, t > "t2g.tsv" }
  # three cells with planted per-gene read counts
  nb=3
  bc[1]="AAACCCAAGAAACACT"; bc[2]="AAACCCAAGAAACCAT"; bc[3]="AAACCCAAGAAACCCA"
  cnt[1,1]=20; cnt[1,2]=10; cnt[1,3]=0
  cnt[2,1]=0;  cnt[2,2]=15; cnt[2,3]=5
  cnt[3,1]=8;  cnt[3,2]=0;  cnt[3,3]=0
  for(c=1;c<=nb;c++) print bc[c] > "barcodes.txt"
  u=0; n=0
  for(c=1;c<=nb;c++) for(t=1;t<=3;t++) for(j=1;j<=cnt[c,t];j++){
    n++; u++
    # UNIQUE 12bp UMI per read: alevin-fry dedups by UMI, so repeats would collapse counts
    umi=""; v=u
    for(i=0;i<12;i++){ umi=umi B[(v%4)+1]; v=int(v/4)+i }
    start=int(rand()*(500-150))
    printf "@rd%d\n%s%s\n+\n%s\n", n, bc[c], umi, "IIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII" > "R1.fastq"
    r2=substr(TX[t], start+1, 150)
    q=""; for(i=0;i<150;i++) q=q "I"
    printf "@rd%d\n%s\n+\n%s\n", n, r2, q > "R2.fastq"
    printf "g%d\t%s\n", t, bc[c] > "truth_pairs.txt"
  }
  for(c=1;c<=nb;c++) for(t=1;t<=3;t++) if(cnt[c,t]>0) printf "%s\tg%d\t%d\n", bc[c], t, cnt[c,t] > "truth.tsv"
  printf "cells %d  genes 3  reads %d  unique_umis %d\n", nb, n, u
}
AWKEOF
awk -f gen.awk | tee fixture.txt
sort truth.tsv -o truth.tsv

echo "== piscem build (index the toy transcriptome) =="
piscem build -s txome.fa -k 31 -m 19 -o idx -t 2 > build.log 2>&1

echo "== piscem map-sc: barcode 16 + UMI 12 on R1, cDNA on R2 =="
piscem map-sc -i idx -g "1{b[16]u[12]x:}2{r:}" -1 R1.fastq -2 R2.fastq -o rad -t 2 > map.log 2>&1
grep -oE "Mapped [0-9]+/[0-9]+ reads \\([0-9.]+%\\)" map.log | tail -1 || true

# a directory output cannot be staged directly; it travels as one flat tar
tar -cf rad.tar rad
ls -l rad.tar | awk '{print "rad_tar_bytes", $5}'
